types.name: Visa-free short stay
types.purpose: Short stays for nationalities that do not need a Cyprus visa (e.g. Serbia, the US, the UK).
types.note: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period in Cyprus. Valid only for the Republic of Cyprus until Cyprus fully joins Schengen; days in Cyprus do not count towards the Schengen 90/180.

types.name: Short-stay visa (type C, 1 or 2 entries)
types.purpose: Tourism, business or family visits of up to 90 days.
types.note: Valid only for the Republic of Cyprus until Cyprus fully joins Schengen; days in Cyprus do not count towards the Schengen 90/180.

types.name: Multiple-entry short-stay visa (type C – MEV)
types.purpose: Frequent travellers to Cyprus with a good visa history.
types.note: Never more than 90 days in any 180-day period. Valid only for the Republic of Cyprus until Cyprus fully joins Schengen; days in Cyprus do not count towards the Schengen 90/180.

types.name: Border visa for transit or short stay (type C – LTV)
types.purpose: Issued at the border only in emergencies, with the approval of the Migration Department.

types.name: Airport transit visa (type A – ATV)
types.purpose: Staying in the international transit zone of a Cypriot airport — for the nationalities that need it.
types.note: Does not allow entry into Cyprus.
